summary: Harden PM12 holdings serving-binding selection in services/control-plane/bff/pm12/service.py and add focused unit tests in services/control-plane/bff/pm12/test_holdings_serving_binding.py wired into .github/workflows/branch-ci.yml and verified by scripts/ci_test_inventory.py.

changes.description: Select the active serving RuntimeBinding per runtime_id in PM12 holdings projection; treat terminal statuses and retirement timestamps (retired_at/ended_at/terminated_at/deleted_at) and telemetry rollover _retired_binding_ids/retired_binding_id as terminal/retired when ranking bindings; prefer active non-terminal PersonaCapitalBindings in plan.binding_ids; deduplicate runtime_id telemetry lookups and pool telemetry rollups; preserve residual positions on genuinely terminal-only runtimes while omitting empty terminal runtimes.

Focused unit tests covering active+retired binding on the same runtime (1 row across both orders, retirement timestamps, and plan binding fallback), multi-persona distinct runtimes (1 row per runtime, deduplicated pool telemetry rollup), and retired-only runtime residual position visibility vs empty terminal omission.

Wire services/control-plane/bff/pm12/test_holdings_serving_binding.py into the service-suites-heavy control_plane pytest step (collected as whole by scripts/ci_test_inventory.py check with 0 exemptions added to docs/operations/ci-test-inventory.json).
